article.title: Effects of virtual reality-based rehabilitation on upper-limb motor function and functional independence after subacute stroke: A systematic review and multilevel meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
article.authors: Pérez-Cárcamo J, Vásquez-Carrasco E, Valdés-Badilla P
article.abstract: Virtual reality (VR)-based rehabilitation has emerged as a promising approach to enhance recovery after stroke; however, its effectiveness during the subacute phase remains unclear. This systematic review and multilevel meta-analysis evaluated the effects of VR-based rehabilitation on upper-limb motor function, manual dexterity, and functional independence in individuals with subacute stroke.
